about_the_game: Imagine if one of the most famous names in the history of classical music rose from the dead and we hired him to make the soundtrack of our video game. Now stop imagining it, for although we don't know any necromancy (yet), we do have a good idea of what Johann Sebastian Bach would sound like centuries later were he to trade the grand majesty of an orchestra for the even grander sounds of a personal computer.

name: The Count Lucanor Soundtrack
short_description: Marvel in the delightfully creepy music of Chiptune Bach and take the soundscape of the castle out of The Count Lucanor and into your Steam Library, with The Count Lucanor Soundtrack!
